depth_findings.text: The question apply has no authority or tool snapshot. Approvals keep one in approvals.continuation_descriptor_json; a question has no such row. Stage 2 needs the pause fold written for an input pause (PauseFold in fold.rs) and check_fold (resume.rs ~1204 refuses any pending kind but Approval) and restore_in_place (resume.rs ~1595 builds an approval pause_ref) extended. Stage 1 needs the tools and authority from the same snapshot or a full gateway rebuild of the turn. Choose the carrier before building the pause: the pause fold (needs the checkpoint flags on) or a descriptor column on run_questions (amends 0071 again).

Migration 0071 was amended in place after commit e94252c1b. If any database applied the earlier file, sqlx checksum validation stops session-core at startup. Confirm before merge (carried from round one).

consume_run_question does not check the run status, and the spend ignores expires_at. After the one-hour hold lapses, recovery can terminalize the answered run while a continuation can still be spent. The gateway preflight must refuse a finished run before any spend (carried from round one).
ConsumeRunQuestion writes no audit or outcome event, unlike ConsumeApproval (RunResumedAfterApproval). The audit risk class needs an owner decision.
The gateway continue branch needs a client for RunQuestionConsumeService. How the gateway builds its orchestration clients is not checked yet; state.rs and main.rs are outside the owned set.

For the awaiting_input frame, requested_question_for_run (model-gateway sse.rs, the user_question path) can supply the question id without a new RunAgentResponse field. A new field would touch 43 struct literals across execution-core, model-gateway and tests.

A question pause has no authority or tool snapshot to resume under (approvals keep one in continuation_descriptor_json). The owner or lead must pick the carrier before the executor pause is built: the pause fold, or a descriptor column on run_questions, which would amend 0071 again.

Migration 0071 was amended in place after commit e94252c1b (it adds consumed_claim_hash and changes the CHECK). Any database that applied the earlier file will fail sqlx checksum validation, and session-core will not start.

consume_run_question checks neither the run status nor any spend window. After the one-hour answered-hold in has_pending_resume_question lapses, recovery can terminalize the run while its answer can still be spent. A run-status predicate or an answered_at window in the CAS would close this.
ConsumeRunQuestion writes no audit or outcome event, unlike ConsumeApproval (RunResumedAfterApproval). This matters because audit is one of the slice's risk classes.
The RunQuestionConsumeService impl is not registered anywhere, so it is unreachable at runtime until the shared grpc.rs edit lands. The compiler will not flag it, because it is a trait impl.
git status lists ask.rs as M, but git diff --quiet shows no content change. It is only a stale stat entry and needs no action beyond a refresh.
